facts.raw_span: stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum
primary site unknown
skin symptoms developed within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, involving nasolabial folds
Creatine kinase: 1088 U/L
Antinuclear antibody titer: 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody: negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis
Grade 4/5 strength on resisted abduction of shoulders bilaterally

concepts.why: The patient developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, and physical findings included photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, and erythema of upper eyelids, which are consistent with dermatomyositis.
The patient has stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma with metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum.
The patient developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, which is consistent with ipilimumab-induced dermatitis.
The patient has elevated creatine kinase levels and muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers, which are consistent with inflammatory myopathy.
The patient has grade 4/5 strength on resisted abduction of shoulders bilaterally, which is consistent with muscle weakness.
The patient has a high antinuclear antibody titer and a negative Jo-1 antibody, which are consistent with an autoimmune disorder.
The patient has stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma with metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum.
The patient has malignant melanoma and developed skin symptoms, which are consistent with a paraneoplastic syndrome.
The negative Jo-1 antibody result does not rule out anti-synthetase syndrome, which can present with similar clinical features and muscle weakness.

rationales.F01: Highly specific finding of stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma, which is strongly associated with C02 and C07.
rationales.F04: Development of skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment suggests an association with C03.
rationales.F07: Elevated creatine kinase levels are a strong indicator of muscle damage, which is consistent with C01, C04, and C05.
rationales.F08: The presence of antinuclear antibodies with a speckled pattern is a strong indicator of an autoimmune disorder, which is consistent with C01, C04, C06, and C09.
rationales.F09: The absence of Jo-1 antibodies makes C09 less likely.
rationales.F11: The absence of inflammatory myositis in the muscle biopsy rules out C04.
